senses.gloss: suṅka (EI 12), a corrupt form of śulka often found in South Indian inscriptions.
suṅka (EI 12), same as Sanskrit śulka, tolls.
Suṅkapannāyadadhiṣṭhāyaka (IE 8-3), Kannaḍa-Sanskrit; superintendent of the income from tolls. See Suṅka-věrgaḍě.
Suṅka-věrgaḍě (EI 19), Kannaḍa; official designation; Sanskrit Śulk-ādhyakṣa. See Suṅkapannāyadadhiṣṭhāyaka.
